requiredFindings.title: A chain past the named budget has no row
requiredFindings.failureScenario: A recorded root chain has 17 links, or its stored bytes and check_value traversal exceed the 16 MiB ChainBudget. Item 11 refuses that chain as an S5 chain-limit row. S5's registered ROOT.* details name a link, ChainError::Limit has no public detail, and the registry has no chain-limit code. Item 10 forbids a new code and does not list this refusal. Required: exceeding ChainBudget uses the existing budget row, WORK.BUDGET_EXHAUSTED, operational-failed, exit 4, SYSTEM.OUTCOME.ILLEGAL_STATE, host-invariant, and the chain is not truncated. A distinct public code is an owner decision scheduled like the two continuation codes.

scope: Law X4T r2. r1 RF-1 through RF-6 are closed. The two continuation codes, class request-rejected exit 2 EXTENSION.ADMISSION_REJECTED, are a sound successor. A chain past ChainBudget names an S5 row the registry does not have. No product cargo.
